No other operation is declared here, and no orchestration method, Java interface or table read is offered as an answer source (BR1, BR10).

The refusal set of the two operations is the one in the table above. A 409 answers a step key whose first run is still RUNNING and a link on a run that already holds another record. The record reference (`decisionLogEntryId`, and the body of the link) is the UUID given by the decision-record library, and it is read back through the record read of rwb-decision before the link is stored. The route in front of the run read is a pass-through of one hop, and its name is agreed with the route contract RWB-PLT-N001-CON.

edits.old: This document declares no agent event: `rwb.agent.AgentRunCompleted.v1` (EV-28) on `rwb.agent.events.v1` belongs to the run path of RWB-P10-E1058-APP and is unchanged here.
edits.new:
This document declares no agent event: `rwb.agent.AgentRunCompleted.v1` (EV-28) on `rwb.agent.events.v1` belongs to the run path of RWB-P10-E1058-APP and is unchanged here.

The calling service appends the record locally in its own schema and transaction and publishes DecisionRecorded on `rwb.decision-record.v1` from its outbox, and rwb-decision collects it into the ledger (DP-03). This supersedes the legacy statement that the client publishes no event and writes through the P7 writer: no event comes from the client of rwb-agent.

The decision code of an agent step is the code in force from LOV-DECISION, carried in the request member `decisionCode`; the fixtures carry D6, and no agent-step sub-decision code is declared (ASM-B-P7-05-TE013-1). The agent run ID, the mode, the fallback and its reason are members of `actions`; `recommendation` and the final call stay separate fields. The code of an agent step is settled with the reference-data owner before the first joint environment.

A record that the ledger ingest refuses is answered with MSG-P7-009 naming the field and is held for the retry and dead-letter path with an alert; nothing is added to the ledger (ASM-B-P7-05-TE013-3). The wording of MSG-P7-009 is approved with the message catalogue of wave 1, and no criterion depends on it.
